mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns do not show a statistically significant negative shift in tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing consumer confidence and economic expansion, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to show positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances with sustained HOUST growth, or the correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased wages and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the short-term correlation between UNRATE decrease and SPX returns is not statistically significant (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity and supply, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a strong consumer-driven economic expansion, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (multivariate regression p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over a 3-month period, indicating rising inflation, typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances with sustained CPIAUCSL growth, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (multivariate regression p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 decline and SPX returns is not statistically significant (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).
